question_en: Rank the main contributors to spec 38.331 (RRC ownership).
original_query: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.331'}), (t)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company) RETURN c.companyName, count(DISTINCT r) AS contributions ORDER BY contributions DESC LIMIT 10
reference_query:
MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec {specNumber:'38.331'}), (t)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company)
RETURN c.companyName AS companyName, count(DISTINCT r) AS contributionCount
ORDER BY contributionCount DESC, companyName ASC
